Big Daddy: Yes sir. The technology has been retrieved.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Those two are still alive.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: The fake African accent? Yes sir, you were right. The white boy bought it without any suspicions, but I still don’t know why that was necessary to begin with. I was born in Michigan. It just seemed like an unnecessary risk.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes sir. I apologize, I will not question your decisions again.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes sir, I recovered all the cameras and other spying equipment from the destroyed lab. In the end, we still don’t know who was operating it or what happened to it.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: No, sir. My cover is intact. Nobody knows who I really am.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes, the concierge knew my identity, but he’s been disposed of. {{wi}}He was being rude to the guests anyway.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes, she filed for divorce after all. Until the very end, I thought she’s just being dramatic and now it’s too late…
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: No sir, I’m not crying… {{wi}}*sniffles*
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes sir, I agree completely. It takes a smart and flexible individual such as yourself to rule the world…
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: What should I do about the nun?
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes sir. I’ll keep her under surveillance.
???: *muzzled*
Big Daddy: Yes. Thank you. Goodbye…{{wi}} Mr. President.
